'''September 2001 Melbourne Sealed Deck tournament (16 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 16 September 2001. It is known from Rodney Lee's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2975">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-melbourne-australia-16-09-2001d2975/ melbourne-australia-16-09-2001], DeckTech (Rodney "DS Pro" Lee, 17 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-melbourne-australia-16-09-2001d2975/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 12
